Mashed Potatoes | Instant Pot Recipes
By: A Kitchen Advisor
Published: Wednesday, February 13, 2019 - 11:34am

Ingredients




3 lb potatoes
1 tbsp salt
2 tbsp melted butter
1/2 cup milk
3 cloves garlic
1/2 cup whipping cream
4 cups water
Fresh rosemary stalk

Preparation

1 Peel potatoes and cut them into cubes. Get rid of the little knots from the potatoes with a tip of a potatoes peeler. Place potatoes in an inner pot and cover them with cold water. Add 1 tbsp salt. Close the lid and turn the valve to the "Sealing" position. Select “Pressure Cook” program and set time to 4 minutes. 2 Meanwhile mix 1/2 cup milk and 1/2 cup whipping cream in a saucepan, then add a rosemary stalk and 3 cloves of mashed garlic. Bring it to boil. Feel free to increase the amount of milk and whipping cream according to your taste. Garlic and rosemary will make your mashed potatoes more flavorful and milk and whipping cream will add smoothness and creaminess. Remove garlic and rosemary with a sieve. 3 When time is up, open the lid by using the quick release i.e. turn the valve to the "Venting" position. Drain potatoes and mash them well with a potato masher. 4 Slowly drizzle in the hot milk sauce. 5 Transfer mashed potatoes to a plate. Add melted butter to bring extra fluffiness. Sprinkle with parsley or dill to bring fresh taste.

Learn how to make garlic Mashed Potatoes in Instant Pot. Above all, this recipe is very basic but still one of the yummiest side dishes on Earth. It can be served with steaks, beef Stroganoff and any other meat or vegetables. The best Instant Pot recipes are not necessarily the most difficult and time consuming. It takes only 4 minutes to make homemade Mashed Potatoes in Pressure Cooker. The total cooking time is about 20 minutes, i.e. 10 minutes to gather steam to start pressure cooking function and 5 minutes for quick release. You might spend another 10 minutes to peel potatoes and get rid of the little knots with your peeling knife.
As always, there is a small but powerful trick which makes the difference between the just fine garlic Mashed Potatoes and the best creamy and flavorful result. The secret ingredients are garlic, rosemary stalk and heavy whipping cream. Certainly, they will give additional creaminess and flavor to your side dish.
